data.one_liner: Didit Identity Verification SDK for Flutter document scanning and NFC.
data.what_it_does: Wraps native iOS and Android SDKs for document scanning, NFC passport reading, face verification, and liveness detection. It provides a unified Dart API to run identity verification workflows inside the app.
use_when: You need to implement identity verification, document scanning, or liveness detection in a Flutter app.
You require NFC passport reading and face verification using native SDK wrappers.
avoid_when: You only need simple camera previews or standard QR code scanning without identity verification workflows.
Your app does not support the required minimum platform versions (iOS 13+/15+, Android API 23+).
strengths: Unified Dart API wrapping robust native iOS and Android SDKs.
Supports multiple variants like core, all, and NFC to optimize app bundle size.
weaknesses: High setup complexity requiring native configurations (Podfile, Gradle properties, Info.plist permissions, NFC capabilities).
Platform-specific limitations such as Swift Package Manager lacking Location verification support.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration in ios/Podfile, android/gradle.properties, Info.plist permissions, and NFC or location capabilities depending on the chosen variant.
